keyFindings.description: Line 122: the merge moved main's no-change check (StateVector + DeleteSetFromDoc before mutate, forkHeld after) into the shared liveOperation.change, so every margin write now does two whole-store walks (buildDeleteSet over every item, then an IDSet copy) for a check that can never fire for it. This is avoidable CPU on the path this PR exists to make cheap. Move the snapshot and the drop back into applyLive around its op.change call, as main has them, and restore change's doc comment.
